name: Glaucoma Detection (Diabetic Screening)
description: Screens a batch of patients for glaucoma from a fundus photograph embedded in each patient's FHIR Bundle; returns a FHIR Bundle of per-patient Observation/DiagnosticReport results.
openApiSpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Glaucoma Detection Service
  description: >
    Dummy AI service that screens patients for glaucoma from a retinal fundus
    photograph embedded in a FHIR Bundle. Accepts a Bundle covering multiple
    patients (each patient's data + fundus image as one Media resource) and
    returns a FHIR Bundle of per-patient classification results.
  version: 0.1.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8082/fhir
paths:
  /glaucoma-screening:
    post:
      summary: Screen a batch of patients for glaucoma from fundus images
      operationId: screenForGlaucoma
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/fhir+json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/InputBundle'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Per-patient glaucoma screening results
          content:
            application/fhir+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OutputBundle'
        '400':
          description: Malformed Bundle, or a patient entry missing a fundus Media resource
components:
  schemas:
    InputBundle:
      type: object
      description: >
        A FHIR Bundle (type collection or batch) whose entries cover multiple
        patients. For each patient, expect Patient + Encounter + a Media
        resource carrying the base64-encoded fundus photo
        (Media.content.data, Media.content.contentType,
        Media.modality.coding.code = "fundus-photo"), optionally alongside
        Condition/Observation/DiagnosticReport context.
      required: [resourceType, type, entry]
      properties:
        resourceType:
          type: string
          enum: [Bundle]
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [collection, batch]
        entry:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/BundleEntry'
    BundleEntry:
      type: object
      properties:
        fullUrl:
          type: string
        resource:
          type: object
          description: Patient, Encounter, Media (fundus photo), Condition, Observation, DiagnosticReport, ...
          additionalProperties: true
    OutputBundle:
      type: object
      description: >
        FHIR Bundle of results. For each input patient, contains the Patient,
        an Observation carrying the classification
        (code=glaucoma-screening-result, valueCodeableConcept =
        glaucoma-detected | no-glaucoma-detected, interpretation POS/NEG),
        and a DiagnosticReport referencing it with a plain-text conclusion.
      required: [resourceType, type, entry]
      properties:
        resourceType:
          type: string
          enum: [Bundle]
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [collection]
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        entry:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              resource:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: true
